discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 9faee6924f: `runPostCheckoutHook` takes `{ signal, env }`, and both callers (`runWorktreeCheckoutHook` and `omp worktree add`) pass `filterChildShellEnv(process.env)`, which strips the `GIT_DIR` family; `pi-natives` can't import `pi-utils`, so the caller supplies the env. Covered by a new test that runs the helper in a child launched with `GIT_DIR` pointing at the source repo; without the fix the hook's `git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir` reports the source `.git`.

Fixed in f43cad40f4: `hook_location` now reads `core.hooksPath` with gix's `trusted_path`, which expands `~/` and `%(prefix)/` as git does (a value that can't be expanded is used literally, as before). Since `hook_path` builds on it, the bash `git worktree add` builtin and commit hooks pick this up too. New Rust test: with `core.hooksPath=~/…` the lookup equals `git rev-parse --git-path hooks/post-checkout`; on the previous commit it returns `<repo>/~/…`. Also checked on Windows against `git rev-parse --git-path` for `~/`, relative and absolute values.

Fixed in e729dfdcd0: when the child environment has any `GIT_CONFIG*` variable, which gix doesn't read, the hook is located by git itself (`git rev-parse --git-path hooks/post-checkout`, through the same abortable, file-captured spawn), as the bash `git worktree add` builtin hands such cases to git via `git_env_redirected`. Without those variables the native lookup is unchanged. New test: `GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS` (as `git -c core.hooksPath=…` passes it) points at a hooks directory gix doesn't see, and the hook runs; it fails on the previous commit.

Fixed in 7264c7630c: only the overrides gix ignores (`GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS`, `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`, `GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM`, `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM`) switch the lookup to git; `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`/`KEY_n`/`VALUE_n` stay with the in-process lookup. New test: with no git on `PATH` and `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0`, an existing hook is still found and reported as `no-git` instead of treated as missing; it fails on the previous commit.

Fixed in 468a63bdfb: only a single leading slash (`/c/…`) counts as MSYS; `//server/share/…` is kept. Verified on Windows with Git for Windows 2.56: `core.hooksPath` is set only in the child environment, to `//localhost/C$/…/unc-hooks`, and git reports `//localhost/C$/…/post-checkout`. The hook runs; with the previous commit's runner it didn't.
